description: C# source targeting .NET Framework 4.x, .NET Core, or .NET 8 that is to be migrated to .NET 10 LTS. Covers ASP.NET MVC / Web API controllers, WinForms, Windows Services, class libraries, and Console apps. Calibrated against the Tier-1 portfolio (Phase 12.0): DDI Inform, Pepperi, PINpoint, Commerce Vision CVe/Enact, Comsense, Abaca, PQ Systems. Key migration risks: HttpContext.Current removal, System.Web.* namespace replacement, Web.config → IConfiguration, Thread.CurrentPrincipal → ClaimsPrincipal, sync-over-async .Result/.Wait() patterns, and Windows-specific P/Invoke in headless services.

claimKinds.label: Invariant
claimKinds.description: Behavioural invariants the method/type must preserve across all valid inputs. Includes return-value contracts, preconditions, postconditions, and thread-safety guarantees.

fields.name: generatorHints
fields.doc: Optional. Per-claim property-test generator hints per ADR-030. When present the 4th gate exercises the claim against generated .NET 10 inputs and the reference .NET Framework binary. When absent the gate skips with skipReason: no_hints.

claimKinds.label: Obsolete API usage
claimKinds.description: Calls to types or members that were removed, moved, or changed breaking semantics between .NET Framework 4.x and .NET 10. The most common: HttpContext.Current (System.Web), ConfigurationManager.AppSettings, System.Web.Mvc.* namespace, HttpServerUtility.MapPath, Thread.CurrentPrincipal set in ASP.NET pipeline, System.Web.HttpResponse.Redirect, TransactionScope with DTC, WCF ServiceModel (client or server), System.Drawing on Linux. Each instance is a blocker for compilation on .NET 10.

fields.name: api_signature
fields.doc: The fully-qualified type or member being called (e.g. 'System.Web.HttpContext.Current', 'System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["key"]', 'System.Web.Mvc.Controller').

fields.name: removal_reason
fields.doc: Removed = type/member gone entirely; Moved = now in a different NuGet package or namespace; SemanticChange = exists but behaves differently; PlatformOnly = still exists but only on Windows; Deprecated = still compiles but flagged for future removal.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: What the call does today and why the current usage breaks on .NET 10.

fields.name: replacement_hint
fields.doc: The recommended .NET 10 replacement (e.g. 'IHttpContextAccessor.HttpContext injected via DI', 'IConfiguration["key"] from appsettings.json', 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Controller').

claimKinds.label: Dependency injection contract
claimKinds.description: Services, repositories, or infrastructure objects the type consumes. In .NET Framework, these were typically instantiated with `new`, pulled from IoC containers via service locators, or accessed through static HttpContext/ConfigurationManager. In .NET 10 they must become constructor-injected dependencies. Captures the interface + lifetime (Singleton, Scoped, Transient) and any lifetime mismatch risks (e.g. a Singleton injecting a Scoped DbContext).

fields.name: current_resolution
fields.doc: How the dependency is currently obtained.

fields.name: contract
fields.doc: What the consuming type expects of the dependency — methods called, assumptions about state.

fields.name: lifetime_risk
fields.doc: Any lifetime mismatch concern (e.g. 'DbContext captured in Singleton causes concurrency issues — must be Scoped or use IDbContextFactory<T>').

claimKinds.label: Async anti-pattern
claimKinds.description: Synchronous blocking on async work — the primary cause of deadlocks when porting ASP.NET MVC to ASP.NET Core. Patterns: `.Result` on a Task, `.Wait()` on a Task, `Task.Run(() => asyncMethod().Result).Result`, `async void` event handlers used for non-event paths, `SynchronizationContext.Current` assumptions. In .NET Framework ASP.NET the synchronisation context makes these 'work by accident'; in ASP.NET Core there is no synchronisation context and the deadlock disappears — but it can still cause thread-pool starvation under load. Must be converted to `await`.

fields.name: expression
fields.doc: The problematic expression as written in source (e.g. 'GetDataAsync().Result', '_repo.SaveAsync().Wait()', 'Task.Run(() => ProcessAsync().Result).Result').

fields.name: deadlock_risk
fields.doc: Risk of deadlock in ASP.NET Core. High = definitely deadlocks; Medium = deadlocks under specific conditions; Low = thread-pool starvation only.

claimKinds.label: Exception handling contract
claimKinds.description: How the method handles, wraps, or propagates exceptions. Critical for HTTP pipeline migration: ASP.NET MVC's HandleError filter, CustomErrors pages, and catch-and-redirect patterns must become ASP.NET Core exception middleware or Problem Details (RFC 9457). Also captures: swallowed exceptions (empty catch blocks), AggregateException unwrapping from Task.Wait(), and catch (Exception ex) when { ex is X } patterns.

fields.name: exception_type
fields.doc: The exception type caught or thrown (e.g. 'Exception', 'SqlException', 'HttpException', 'AggregateException').

fields.name: migration_note
fields.doc: Specific .NET 10 replacement advice (e.g. 'Replace HttpException(404) throw with Results.NotFound()', 'AggregateException.InnerException unwrapping becomes unnecessary when awaiting the Task directly').

claimKinds.label: Configuration access
claimKinds.description: Reads from Web.config, App.config, or environment variables via ConfigurationManager, WebConfigurationManager, or direct environment reads. Must migrate to IConfiguration + appsettings.json + environment variable provider in .NET 10. Includes: connection strings, AppSettings keys, custom config sections, and Windows Registry reads for config values.

fields.name: key_or_path
fields.doc: The config key or registry path being read (e.g. 'SmtpServer', 'DefaultConnection', 'HKCU:\\Software\\MyApp\\Settings').

fields.name: dotnet10_path
fields.doc: Where this value should live in .NET 10 (e.g. 'appsettings.json:Email:SmtpServer', 'appsettings.json:ConnectionStrings:Default', 'IOptions<MyAppSettings>.Value.Setting').

claimKinds.label: Side effect
claimKinds.description: Externally-visible state mutations: database writes (SqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery, EF SaveChanges), file I/O (File.WriteAllText, StreamWriter), HTTP outbound calls (WebClient, HttpWebRequest, HttpClient), Windows Event Log writes, email sends (SmtpClient), queue/message-bus publishes, Windows Registry writes, P/Invoke calls to native DLLs.

claimKinds.label: Edge case
claimKinds.description: Boundary and failure conditions. C#/.NET migration-specific edges: null vs empty string handling in legacy string methods, DateTime.Kind (Unspecified vs Utc vs Local) mismatch across timezone boundaries, int overflow without checked context, decimal/double precision loss at the boundary, Encoding.Default (ANSI on Windows → UTF-8 on Linux in .NET 10), Path.Combine separator differences between Windows and Linux, System.Drawing.Bitmap (not supported on Linux in .NET 10).

claimKinds.label: Open question
claimKinds.description: Ambiguities the source does not resolve that require SME sign-off before migration can proceed. Common C# cases: Windows-only P/Invoke that cannot run on Linux (must decide whether to keep Windows-only or find a cross-platform replacement), connection pooling behaviour differences between SqlConnection and Npgsql, ThreadStatic / CallContext vs AsyncLocal when porting to async, WCF service references that need gRPC or REST replacement, COM Interop usage in .NET 4.x code.

topLevelFields.name: source_framework
topLevelFields.doc: The detected or declared source TFM. Determines which obsolete APIs apply and which migration guides are relevant.

topLevelFields.name: target_archetype_hint
topLevelFields.doc: Migration target paradigm chosen during Discovery. MinimalApi = Carter/Minimal API; BlazorWebApp = Blazor Web App SSR+WASM; WebApiControllers = MVC-style controller with Swagger; WorkerService = IHostedService + Generic Host.

ioFieldShape.directionDescription: C# parameter modifiers. `in` = value parameter (default), `ref` = ref parameter, `out` = out parameter, `return` = method return value, `optional` = optional parameter with default value.

promptHints.emphasis: Flag every HttpContext.Current, ConfigurationManager, System.Web.*, WebClient, HttpWebRequest, and Thread.CurrentPrincipal usage as obsoleteApiUsage claims. For every new X() instantiation of a service/repository/DbContext, raise a dependencyInjectionContract claim naming the recommended DI lifetime. For any .Result or .Wait() on a Task, raise an asyncAntiPattern claim with deadlock_risk: High (ASP.NET), Medium (WinForms), or Low (console). For every Web.config or AppSettings key access, raise a configurationAccess claim with the recommended appsettings.json path. P/Invoke calls targeting Windows-only DLLs that cannot be ported to Linux are automatic openQuestion candidates — the SME must decide whether the target deployment is Windows-only or cross-platform.

calibratedAgainst: Tier-1 portfolio Phase 12.0 (Pepperi, DDI Inform, PINpoint, Commerce Vision CVe, InfinityQS Enact, Comsense, Abaca, PQ Systems)
